medicine.name: CEFIXIME ARROW LAB 200 mg, comprimé pelliculé

indications_transcribed: Complicated or uncomplicated lower urinary tract infections, except prostatitis
Bacterial superinfections of acute bronchitis and exacerbations of chronic bronchitis
posology_transcribed: Adults and children over 12 years: 400 mg/day in two administrations 12 hours apart.
Gonococcal urethritis: the supplied text indicates a single dose of two 200 mg tablets (400 mg).
If creatinine clearance is below 20 mL/min, including haemodialysis: do not exceed 200 mg/day in one administration.
No dosage adjustment stated for hepatic impairment.
contraindications_transcribed: Hypersensitivity to cefixime, a cephalosporin antibiotic, or an excipient.
warnings_and_precautions_transcribed: Stop treatment if an allergic manifestation occurs.
Use particular caution in patients with penicillin allergy because of possible cross-allergy.
Consider antibiotic-associated and pseudomembranous colitis in patients with diarrhoea.
Serious skin reactions, haemolytic anaemia and encephalopathy are described.
Dose adjustment may be needed in severe renal impairment.
excipients: The supplied excerpt lists pregelatinized maize starch, calcium hydrogen phosphate, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, hypromellose, polyvinyl alcohol, titanium dioxide, talc, soy lecithin and xanthan gum; verify against the official RCP because the OCR text is imperfect.
